item.title: From complex to simple: Analyzing prospective teachers' analogy reasoning in creating accessible geometry problems
item.description: Students often struggle to identify relevant analog problems when solving new tasks, highlighting the need for teachers to design simple analog problems that serve as scaffolding. This study aims to analyze prospective teachers’ analogical reasoning processes in simplifying complex geometry problems using the Analogical Reasoning in Mathematics (ARM) framework. item.title: Numeracy literacy outcomes of RME with local wisdom across cognitive styles
item.description: Numeracy literacy is a crucial skill involving the use of numbers, symbols, and basic mathematical concepts in daily life. However, PISA results indicate that Indonesian students’ numeracy literacy remains low, highlighting the need for effective learning models. item.title: Examination of students' written mathematical communication skills in addressing gender-based open-ended problems
item.description: Written mathematical communication skills are an important concern in mathematics education. One way to assess these skills is by presenting students with open-ended problems. This study examines differences in written mathematical communication skills based on gender. item.description: The background of this research is based on previous studies that emphasize the importance of mastering basic teaching skills for prospective teachers to support effective learning. item.title: Environment on students’ mathematical representation abilities: A quantitative study in an Indonesian secondary school
item.description: This quantitative study aims to examine the influence of the learning environment on students’ mathematical representation abilities.
